page.layout: Running head at top: page number 124 left, title "Roma Irreconciliabilis" right. One main text column in the centre, with a narrow column of marginal notes on the left. Below the text, a catchword "medi-" at the right foot.

main_text.p: aucti canonis, secunda negatç Hier. adu erf. Helvidium. ἀυτιρρῆσις, tertia suspensæ ab Ecclesia authoritatis: Corruptissimam enim sacrarum literarum versionem Tridentinis vnicè authenticam (de qua, iure bono Reuchlinus Hieronymi vestigia premens, Hebræi fontes, Græci riuos, Latini paludes bibunt) sciens prudensque prætereo. Inprimis quis ferat ἐπίβλημα ἐξ παλαιοῦ ἀγναφου adsui panno veteri? aut quid hinc nisi χεῖρον χρυσὸν? Quis ferat vt contra Hebræorum fidem, contra Melitonis, Cyrilli, Athanasij, Origenis, Hilarij, Hieronymi, Ruffini, Nazianzeni clarissima testimonia, contra Doctores
Recensuimus hæc largius. Præf. ad pacem Roma. Ep. ad Onesic. Euf. Cyr cat. 4. Ath. in synopsi. Or. cit. ab Euf. l. 6. & Præf. in Psf. Hier. Prol. Gal. Ruf. Symb. Naz. in Carm.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are small and partly illegible; the Greek phrases in the text are reproduced as best read. The Greek in "ἐπίβλημα ... ἀγναφου" and "χεῖρον χρυσὸν" is doubtful. The catchword "medi-" is at the foot right.
